scope: Stage 5, skull: read-only architecture review and authorized targeted geometry-kind UI presentation

existingArchitecture.canonicalRecord: site/atlas-landmarks.js indexes one pin object by stable id and every relations[].bone; the same object is retained under all contributing bones.
existingArchitecture.legacyCompatibility: b is retained as navigation owner; sh is legacy catalogue/context. catalogueBones controls own TA98 term membership independently of anatomical contributions.
existingArchitecture.search: landmarkSearchOwner returns the selected related bone or the existing owner; renderList produces one result per instance rather than copies under each bone.
existingArchitecture.selection: select retains the active shared landmark while switching between related bones. activeBoundaryBones and contributingBoneIds preserve contributing bones in isolation and xray views.
existingArchitecture.uncertainCoordinates: hasLandmarkPosition rejects anchorStatus=unverified. currentPins and flyToPin honor this; historic coordinates remain in data without a visible/selectable 3D marker.
existingArchitecture.coordinateGenerator: scripts/make_shared_landmarks.py checks reviewed model hashes and original p/n before reusing jugular temporal boundary anchors. It does not synthesize positions for new records.

findings.status: UI support implemented; metadata and browser verification owned by parent task
findings.detail: Existing loc values surface/projection/internal/variant express placement confidence/context, not whether the named structure is a point, area, line, interosseous space or volume. Previously all markers used point buttons and only free-text modelNote distinguished extent.
findings.change: Optional geometryKind renders a machine-readable data-geometry-kind and an explicit explanatory label in the selected landmark card. Missing field renders no inferred category. Existing loc, p/n, IDs, raycasting, BVH and clipping are unchanged.
findings.limits: No region, curve, contour or volume is constructed. Non-point markers explicitly do not define the complete anatomy. An unlocated or suppressed record receives no marker-completeness claim.

findings.finding: Head validation assumes every original term must retain coordinates
findings.status: Recommended targeted follow-up only if a genuinely unlocated original skull record is introduced
findings.detail: The generator already supports a missing reviewed position, but verify_head.py requires positions() to equal the entire catalogue and requires p/n for every pin. A justified conversion of an invalid coordinate to unlocated would fail as incomplete, even if its stable ID, terminology and explicit limitation were retained.
findings.recommendation: Keep full catalogue/ID coverage checks. Distinguish a documented unlocated/suppressed result from an accidentally missing record. Do not remove the coverage assertion merely to make tests pass. Existing in-place suppression already works without changing historic p/n.

findings.finding: Existing PIN-005 fallback is outside the skull batch
findings.status: Existing unresolved issue retained; not changed
findings.detail: Legacy markers without loc default to surface. The ledger already assigns the affected old arm/leg markers and variants to PIN-005. Original 521 skull records have loc, and newly unlocated shared records render no point; no global arm/leg data correction was attempted.

findings.finding: Reference presence and API tests are not independent anatomical acceptance
findings.detail: The head test counts distinct URLs; shared relation tests require distinct declared authorGroup values and locators. These checks catch missing metadata but cannot establish factual support or genuine source independence. Anatomical review remains a separate acceptance step.

minimalExtensionPath: Add a scientifically reviewed definition in scripts/shared_landmark_catalogue.py or an in-place patch in scripts/shared_landmarks.py; preserve pre-existing id, c, b, p and n.
Supply per-relation references with verified authorGroup and exact locators. Do not use a view/launch list as evidence of bone participation.
Add independently reviewed geometryKind metadata without converting loc or inferring it from missing coordinates.
Regenerate pins through scripts/make_shared_landmarks.py; regenerate skull-whole derived data where catalogue cross-navigation changes. No model package rebuild is needed.
Keep a coordinate absent or explicitly suppressed until accepted on the relevant specimen. A line/area/space/volume classification does not itself authorize drawing geometry.

uiContract.unrecognizedValue: Safely displayed as unknown, never interpolated into markup
uiContract.nonPointLocatedText: Маркер показывает отдельную опорную точку. Он не задаёт полную линию, границы, поверхность или объём структуры.

checksThisReview.indexLocalHelperParity: passed after normalizing CRLF/LF; the first byte-substring comparison reflected newline normalization, not a missing helper
checksThisReview.browser: Not run here; root task controls Playwright MCP
checksThisReview.geometry: Not run here; no geometry changes

recommendedChecks.mcpSharedScenario: node tools/verify-shared-landmarks.mjs --mcp 1280 light emits a function suitable for Playwright MCP browser_run_code; repeat targeted cases at 390 dark.
recommendedChecks.mcpRelationScenario: node tools/verify-shared-landmarks.mjs --mcp-expansion 1280 light <offset> <limit> skip supports bounded relation-edge testing. Default final checks also enter the leg, so skip them for a strict skull-only case and use the jugular scenario for UI regressions.
recommendedChecks.mcpNewAssertions: For reviewed geometryKind records, assert the chosen kind label in .pinbox; non-point records explicitly disclaim full extent; unlocated/suppressed records create zero overlay pins; select from every related bone, search once per instance and retain ID through isolation/xray.
recommendedChecks.serverCaveat: Prior stage-4 evidence records ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT for a sandboxed server. Use the same loopback server via authorized hidden Start-Process if that occurs; registration is not proof of connectivity.
